rationale: The ES product pricing card lists activity-based, workload and ingest pricing, while the model FAQ names Splunk Cloud Platform for activity-based eligibility. The 8.8 licensing guide confirms the separate 30-day Essentials and 90-day Premier trials and the Premier trial Cloud Connected entitlement display. The card and licensing guide do not establish customer-managed activity-based eligibility.

versions: Current public pricing and versioned ES 8.8 licensing
exclusions: No tenant rollout, entitlement, authorization or environment-specific approval is inferred.
